name: Anaheim Qualifier 2019
information: * This is a qualifying competition for CubingUSA National Championship 2019 and WCA World Championship 2019. You may still attend this competition even if you will not be attending any of the above mentioned competitions. * There is no 3x3 at this competition. * The registration fee of $20.00 will be paid in cash on the day of the competition. Please do not register if you will not be attending. * Please do not register for blindfolded events if you cannot solve cubes blindfolded. * If you choose to compete in Clock, please make sure you have a Clock that is competition legal. Regulations regarding Clock can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html#article-3-puzzles).
